engine.name: Market Core V2.0-Alpha
engine.status: business behavior preserved from validated 39.2.11; global application version is 39.2.17

notes: 39.2.17 returns to the validated 39.2.11 Math Core window behavior; rejected 39.2.12–39.2.16 Math Core background experiments are not used as functional bases.

The only functional UI change is removal of the Math Core floating 760px !important max-width ceiling; the existing Administrator inline width may now size the real #math host up to the viewport limit.
This makes the native #math background, border and atmospheric layer cover the same real width as the Math Core content instead of stopping at 760px.
No extra backdrop, pseudo background, ResizeObserver, MutationObserver, DOM clone, chart change, Atlas change or Memory change is introduced.
The generic Administrator window manager and its storage namespace erith_admin_portal_39_2_9 remain unchanged.
